title: Wobbly fit — contextual fit restoration and distance to fit
summary: dev11 formalizes model-relative wobbliness: find the smallest observation set whose temporary exclusion restores a declared fit, retain all equally minimal restoring sets, measure distance-to-fit and normative wobbliness, and reassign evidence explicitly rather than deleting it.
authority: Executable dev11 source/tests and the radar two-track demo are authoritative. Wobble means incompatibility with the active fit, not falsehood, noise, anomaly, or irrelevance in every model.
invariants: Wobbliness is relative to an active model and fit criterion; a valid observation can be wobbly here and highly relevant elsewhere.
Exclusion is diagnostic only and never deletion authority.
Distance-to-fit is the minimum number of observations that must be temporarily set aside before the criterion is satisfied.
Search proceeds by increasing cardinality and retains every restoring set at the first successful cardinality.
A bounded exact search must fail closed when its evaluation budget is exceeded rather than silently becoming approximate.
Participation across alternative minimal restoring sets is evidence about explanatory stability, not guilt or error probability.
Normative wobbliness is a distribution of expected fit-restoration fractions, not merely a mean.
Reassignment is explicit: alternate track/source/model, normative clutter, measurement error, unresolved, or another declared disposition.
Changing fit threshold, model, or normative baseline creates a different analysis history; MLWobbleStudy is driveable and branchable.
procedure: Choose a scorer that returns MLFitAssessment and declare MLFitCriterion with explicit direction and threshold.
Run MLWobbleSetSearch with maxRemovals and maxEvaluations appropriate to the bounded problem.
Inspect the full baseline and individual leave-one-out influence, but do not assume the strongest individual is in the best multi-item restoring set.
Inspect all minimal restoring sets, distanceToFit, normalizedDistance and MLWobbleParticipation.
When historical reference data exists, supply MLWobbleNorm and inspect percentile/p50/p95/normativeClass.
Re-test excluded observations against alternate tracks/sources/models and record MLWobbleReassignment explicitly.
Use MLWobbleStudy when analytical history, rollback or branching of fit policy matters.
Run examples/wobbly_radar_demo.rex: the mixed 12-return fixture has distance-to-fit 3; B3/B6/B9 restore Track A to RMS 0 and themselves fit Track B to RMS 0.

provenance.claim: Executable fit-restoration, normative, participation, reassignment and driveable-study semantics.
Canonical contextual-reassignment demo with two coherent radar tracks.
63-test and 18-surface compiler qualification; SSC re-baseline explicitly not claimed.
